name: biocad
description: BioCAD - native workstation for molecular, protein, and pharmacological analysis (docking, ADMET, similarity, legal-analog, AI agent).

science.description: Networked extras (Phase D agent): libcurl for the Anthropic LLM provider. curl[ssl] resolves to Windows-native Schannel TLS here (the port's ssl feature pulls sspi on Windows), so there is no OpenSSL build. NOTE: there is intentionally no rdkit - BioCAD has its own in-house cheminformatics engine in src/chem (rdkit is not a port in this vcpkg registry).

webview2.description: Optional WebView2 headless JS-render fetch for web_fetch (Win10/11; needs the Evergreen WebView2 Runtime at runtime). The vcpkg port links the static loader on x64-windows-static, so the single exe stays DLL-free. Pulls in WIL (header-only).
